data.long_meaning: The name Jennie is derived from the name Jeanne or Jane, which is the feminine form of John. The name John means ‘God is gracious’. Thus, the name Jennie can be interpreted as ‘God is gracious to her’ or ‘God’s gracious one’. In the Middle Ages, the name Jane was popularized by the legend of Joan of Arc, a heroine of France who led the country to victory during a time of war.
